description.purpose: GH #617: the receiving half of a colony boundary -- a peer cell mounted on the colony's one listener that accepts one declared lane, a sink where an arrival lands, and a sink for the receipts it books.
description.use_when: As the south tree of the two-colony proof, behind a reverse proxy that writes the sender into `X-Meclaw-Peer`.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no wall clock, no answer back to the sender beyond the receipt on the wire.
examples: a frame on lane 'topic' from behind the proxy arrives under /sink with hop.peer set to the header value
a frame on any other lane is refused with 'lane_undeclared' and booked under /receipts
